dialogues.speaker: Rudaba
dialogues.text: Playing Genius Invokation TCG is also a way of relaxing. Sometimes, you need to distract yourself from your research...

dialogues.speaker: Rudaba
dialogues.text: So that you can be more focused later. It's not gonna work if you keep exhausting yourself. So, care for a duel?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've got other things to do right now...

dialogues.speaker: Rudaba
dialogues.text: That's alright. When you have the time, we can have our duel then.

dialogues.speaker: Rudaba
dialogues.text: I won, didn't I? Even though I belong to Amurta, I'm a researcher nonetheless. Don't underestimate me!

dialogues.speaker: Rudaba
dialogues.text: How come you managed to crack it? Amazing...
